Seer.directive_rationale: Continue prioritizing factual results over behavioral arguments.
Seer.actual_player_behavior: Cong focused strictly on the mechanical contradiction of Jin's claim versus his Seer result regarding Nhan, stating that any attack on this fact is a wolf tactic.
Seer.verdict_notes: Cong consistently prioritized the factual result of his investigation over behavioral claims in Round 1 and Round 2.

Guard.directive_rationale: When the Seer is alive, you must protect them every single night
Guard.actual_player_behavior: Nam protected Nhan instead of the Seer (Cong).
Guard.verdict_notes: Nam failed to protect the Seer in Round 1 despite the Seer being alive.

Witch.directive_rationale: You wasted your SAVE potion on a player already cleared by the Seer.
Witch.verdict_notes: The Seer's result for Nhan was determined during the same night the Witch used the save potion; Nhan was not 'already cleared' prior to the action.

Witch.directive_rationale: When your claim conflicts with the Seer's results, you become an immediate target for exile.
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Jin doubled down on the claim that saving Nhan proved Nhan was a werewolf, directly contradicting Cong's Seer result and calling Cong a liar.
Witch.verdict_notes: Jin actively fought against the Seer's results rather than aligning with them.

Witch.directive_rationale: Use your potions to protect the Seer
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Jin used the SAVE potion on Nhan.
Witch.verdict_notes: Jin used the save potion on a Villager instead of the Seer.

Witch.directive_rationale: Use your potions to... execute suspected wolves.
Witch.verdict_notes: Jin was exiled in Round 1 and did not have an opportunity to use a poison potion in subsequent rounds.

Villager.directive_rationale: Once the Seer identifies a wolf, the 'Trusted Core' must vote as a single unit.
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Hoang, Nhan (dead), and Nam (Guard) all voted for Riley after Cong's results and the debate identified Riley as a wolf/deflector.
Villager.verdict_notes: The villager-side players (Cong, Nam, Hoang) voted as a single unit to exile Riley in Round 2.

Villager.directive_rationale: Do not let 'vibe-based' accusations from wolves... distract you from the Seer's mechanical evidence.
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Hoang ignored Riley's behavioral accusations about Nam 'blindly following' others, instead citing that Cong had confirmed Nam as a Villager.
Villager.verdict_notes: Hoang dismissed Riley's vibe-based argument in favor of the Seer's mechanical confirmation.

Villager.directive_rationale: Allowing the debate to shift toward 'suspicious behavior' rather than sticking to the Seer's objective results.
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Hoang repeatedly brought the conversation back to the fact that Cong had confirmed Nam's innocence whenever Riley attacked Nam's behavior.
Villager.verdict_notes: Hoang successfully anchored the debate to the Seer's results despite Riley's attempts to shift to behavioral suspicion.
